text: Hi all, rota update for the Saturday shifts at the Northgate food bank. Aino Tauriainen can't do 9-12 on the 16th any more, so Nguyen Thi Lan is swapping with her and Aino will take Lan's 1-4 slot on the 23rd instead. Dev Raghunathan is still on the van run both weeks, but he's asked for a second person to help lift because the crates are about 18 kg each. If anyone can join Dev, text him on 07700 900233 rather than replying here. New volunteers need to finish the 20-minute food hygiene video before their first shift; Lan has the link. Aino's number has changed to 07700 900871, so please update your contacts. We're short 2 people for the 30th, and we can't open the second distribution table unless we have at least 6 volunteers.
